_comment: A pinned set of spot prices, for reproducing a valuation at a known moment or
for running when no price source is reachable. NEVER used automatically: the
fetchers fail loudly rather than silently serving stale prices, so this only
loads behind an explicit --snapshot flag, and every surface that uses it says so.
Spot prices only - no history. That is enough for the valuation page, which needs
four numbers, but not for the daily report's moving averages, volatility,
correlations or Monte Carlo forecast, all of which need a real series. Those
surfaces report unavailable under --snapshot rather than inventing a history.
Captured 2026-08-22 for the 7:45pm ET valuation. The BTC and ETH stamps are the
closest quotes available at capture time, both earlier in the day than 19:45 ET;
crypto trades continuously, so they will have moved since. MSTR is a Friday close:
2026-08-22 is a Saturday, so there is no Saturday equity print.
source: public quote reporting gathered 2026-08-22; not exchange-official

MSTR.note: Friday close; +6.10% on the day. Aug 22 is a Saturday - no equity session.
